copilot_presets.question: Why did the defensive press fail at 76:04?
copilot_presets.question_zh: 为什么 76:04 的高位逼抢被瞬间打穿？
copilot_presets.answer: At 76:04 (e-001027), the ball carrier faced 0.51 pressure (40.4th match percentile) but released a vertical pass gaining +37.5m and +0.118 xT before the second wave could close the passing lane.
copilot_presets.answer_zh: 在 76:04（事件 e-001027），持球人在承受 0.51 压迫指数（全场前 59.6% 强度）下，用一记纵向穿透球直接推进 +37.5 米并创造 +0.118 xT 威胁增量，在合围形成前打穿了中场防线。

copilot_presets.question: Was this counter-attack the fastest sprint of the match?
copilot_presets.question_zh: 这次反击冲刺是全场比赛的最高速度吗？
copilot_presets.answer: No. FactChecker and MCP get_pressure_comparison verified that while this sequence reached 33.4 km/h (e-001027), the match peak was 34.1 km/h recorded in event e-000245. Any superlative claim is automatically withheld.
copilot_presets.answer_zh: 不是。FactChecker 与 MCP 工具 get_pressure_comparison 交叉核验显示：当前时刻速度为 33.4 km/h（e-001027），而全场真实最高冲刺速度为 34.1 km/h（事件 e-000245）。任何伪造“全场最快”的口径都会被确定性门禁自动拦截。

copilot_presets.question: Why did the Director schedule this cue for the next stoppage window?
copilot_presets.question_zh: 为什么 Director 导播智能体将这张战术卡排期到下一个死球窗口？
copilot_presets.answer: Director enforces a 60-second duplicate suppression window and a 15-second minimum lower-third gap. With importance 0.80 and 2 verified metrics, it ranks #1 in the rundown and targets the earliest stoppage window so live ball action is never obstructed.
copilot_presets.answer_zh: Director 严格执行 60 秒同类事件去重与 15 秒字幕最小间隔约束。该时刻重要性达 0.80 且通过了 2 项确定性指标核验，因此排在导播单第 1 顺位，并锁定最近的死球窗口安全上屏。
